grid=[list(map(int,l.split())) for l in grid_txt.splitlines()]
from collections import deque
R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
for r in range(R):
 for c in range(C):
  if grid[r][c]!=7 and (r,c) not in seen:
   q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
   while q:
    x,y=q.pop();cells.append((x,y))

     a,b=x+dx,y+dy
     if 0<=a<R and 0<=b<C and grid[a][b]!=7 and (a,b) not in seen:
      seen.add((a,b));q.append((a,b))
   colors={grid[x][y] for x,y in cells}
   comps.append((min(x for x,y in cells),max(x for x,y in cells),min(y for x,y in cells),max(y for x,y in cells),colors,len(cells)))
